description.en: Sets one setting of a camera. Names: "Fov" (field of view, in degrees), "Stereo", "Smooth" (1 on, 0 off), "DepthLevel" and "DepthRange" (depth-of-field settings, see CMND_DEPTHLEVEL_FADE and CMND_DEPTHRANGE_FADE). For Smooth, 0 turns smoothing off and any other value turns it on.

true once set.
false if the camera is not found or the name is unknown.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments are given.

examples.case: Depth of field at the start of a skill scene (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut)
